operation: Local artifact and raw Git object reads only; no network or distribution mutations.

foundation.note: App source is covered by the signed upload receipt; tests/scripts/project by the test receipt. ios/.gitattributes is proven by the exact frozen commit, not a nonexistent archive hash entry.

upload.versionSource: Signed archive Info.plist as recorded by testflight.sh, not a workflow-number guess.

limitations: Archive version/build is attested by the CI receipt generated from its actual signed Info.plist; the IPA itself is not included in these artifacts.
An Apple processing receipt alone does not prove existing-group availability.
TestFlight availability does not prove installation on a particular iPhone or App Store publication.

steps.name: Read exact build and existing group availability
